verdicts.reason: Both leave the original's white label frame stranded empty in the middle of the banner, cutting the brand lockup (LAVANDER/SKINCARE) off from HOMEMADE LOTION. A's frame also holds stray divider rules that point at nothing, and SKINCARE hangs as a superscript beside LAVANDER. B's empty white blob is just as meaningless, and B pushes LAVANDER almost against the left edge of the canvas, so it has no margin. B's illustrations are slightly larger, but A's better left margin makes it marginally less broken.
